credit: Models by jelaludo (the owner's own; https://jelaludo.github.io/SentryTowers_A6/), imported for the owner's note of 2026-11-07: STALHEART-KIDOU, the mobile fabrication gantry (the Terraformer 3000 / STALHEART gantry on two 24 m chassis beams and eight independently steered XB-12 wheels, revision 2, wheels directly beneath the beams), and the SAI-93, the headless, narrower and longer SAI-92 mineral hopper (revision 1), at `revision` (2026-11-06). D0 only, game tier LOD1 and static distance tier LOD2, plain GLB (the build meshopt-packs them; measured 2026-11-07: nothing is lost, see `models.*.pack`). LOD0 (7.6 MB / 1.1 MB) is left upstream, as round 8 left it. `clips: []`: neither model has a baked clip, both are engine-driven through named nodes by the author's runtime.js adapters, kept verbatim and dependency-injected with the game's Three. The SAI-93 shares the SAI-92 service bay: upstream's sai93_bay_d0_lod{1,2}.glb are byte-identical to assets/models/sai92/sai92_bay_d0_lod{1,2}.glb (docs/a6-settlement-assets.lock.json), so they are not pinned twice. `requiredNodes` (checked by scripts/assets.mjs) lists every name the adapters look up plus the sockets. Hashes match the author's manifests'. The author's READMEs/manifests are in the vault (projects/stalheart/a6-2026-11-07/).

stalheart-kidou.label: STALHEART-KIDOU, mobile fabrication gantry (author's revision 2; the outboard revision 1 is upstream commit 2f7cbd4d)
stalheart-kidou.units: metres, +Y up, +Z forward; root STALHEART_KIDOU_ROOT at the ground, plot centre
stalheart-kidou.dimensionsNote: X width / Y height / Z length, neutral parked surface bounds (Y 0.0031 to 39.86), the same in LOD1 and LOD2 (measured with the vendored GLTFLoader, Box3 of the scene; equals the author's manifest)
stalheart-kidou.plotNote: reserve 48 x 28 m around the moving root and rotate it with the machine; travel and turning need more
stalheart-kidou.wheels: eight XB-12 wheels (3.6x scale), centres X +-16 m at Z +9, +3, -3, -9; rolling radius 1.82 m; trailing arm 3 m (drop 2.4, trail 1.8), pivot Y 4.22; suspension travel -0.55..+0.55 m; steer about Y (crab 90 deg, parked +-90 deg), spin about X

sockets_m.SOCKET_DAMPER_LOWER_*: X +-16, Y 2.3, Z station - 0.36 (follows the arm)

stalheart-kidou.socketsNote: neutral parked pose, root frame; EXTRUSION_TIP follows the arm (3.21 m parked is above the MORK's 3.016 m height: the tool prints over a full-size MORK at SOCKET_FABRICATION_ORIGIN)
stalheart-kidou.engineNodes: BODY_HEAVE; CARRIAGE_TRAVEL_X, TOOL_LIFT_Z, J1_BASE_YAW, J2_SHOULDER, J3_ELBOW, J4_FOREARM_ROLL, J5_WRIST_PITCH, J6_TOOL_ROLL; per wheel SUSP_PIVOT_, UPRIGHT_, WHEEL_STEER_, WHEEL_SPIN_, DAMPER_AIM_, DAMPER_ROD_; FEED_HOSE_1/2 are procedural meshes (the adapter replaces their TubeGeometry when the carriage moves); GANTRY_TRAVEL_Y is the old rail control, fixed at [0, 3.9, 0] (never play the Terraformer's rail clip on it); WHEEL_MOUNT_BRIDGES is a legacy name for the short clevises
stalheart-kidou.runtime: assets/models/stalheart-kidou/runtime.js: stateAt(time, mode) is a demo input generator (modes park, drive, crab, turn, suspension, fabricate; a 16 s cycle); applyKidou(THREE, scene, {time, mode, vx, vz, omega, distance, turnAngle, steerDeg, compression, bias, terrain, carriageX}) poses wheels, suspension (terrain contact by callback), dampers, the arm and the hoses and returns {maxContactError}; it never moves the root (the root owns translation and yaw) and returns {static:true} on LOD2. Travel raises the lift to -2.4 m, parked/fabricate lowers it to -10.45 m (relative to the carriage)

tiers.lod1: game tier, 15,545 triangles / 45 draws / 405,820 B, one vertex-colour material KIDOU_PALETTE, no textures; within the 25k articulated-unit budget, over the 8k / 10 draws / 400 KB stationary landmark budget (the author reports it, does not claim it)
tiers.lod2: static parked distance proxy, 2,756 triangles / 1 draw / 154,136 B; root extras static:true; lookup names retained but never animated
tiers.lod0: 159,668 triangles / 45 draws / 7,635,300 B, close shots and recordings; NOT pinned (left upstream, sha256 20fa84d8...)
tiers.thresholds: author's provisional 150 m enter / 170 m return for the distance tier, not measured game-camera values

stalheart-kidou.pack: no custom vertex attributes (POSITION, NORMAL, COLOR_0 only), no textures, no skins, no morph targets. Packed with the build's own arguments (-cc -noq -kn -km -ke) 2026-11-07: LOD1 405,820 -> 236,408 B, LOD2 154,136 -> 103,504 B; every node name (134 / 135 with the scene), every node's extras (61 / 134) and the root's userData (lod, static) survive; FEED_HOSE_1/2 still load as Meshes; the adapter posed plain and packed copies through drive/fabricate/suspension/turn on a terrain callback with sockets within 3.6e-7 m. NOT added to scripts/build.mjs's UNPACKED list.
stalheart-kidou.diorama: the game-tier sources of the author's stalheart-diorama (144 s) are this LOD1, ISAO LOD1 (assets/models/isao), the MORK low tier (assets/models/hover-tank/mork_hover_tank_low_d0.glb) and the Dome Colony habitat LOD1 (assets/models/dome-colony): all four are now pinned in the game, byte-identical to the layout.json's hashes

sai93.label: SAI-93, long-chassis mineral recovery (author's revision 1): the SAI-92 without its head (no SENSOR_YAW / SENSOR_SURFACE in any tier), 10.4% narrower and 25.2% longer, a longer, narrower ore tank (2.75 x 1.42 x 2.89 m)
sai93.units: metres, +Y up, +Z forward; root SAI93_ROOT at the ground, plot centre
sai93.dimensionsNote: X / Y / Z, the author's neutral landed bounds (manifest; LOD2 measures the same). Box3 of LOD1's GLB rest pose measures 5.66 x 3.575 x 5.7535: the four LEG_*_ANCHOR_SPIKES reach Z +-2.8767 before the adapter poses the legs. SAI-92 was 6.3172 x 3.9945 x 4.5792
sai93.socketsNote: neutral landed pose, root frame (measured, equal to the manifest); the offload tube's full extension puts the outlet at Z 3.18, 0.4033 m from the bay's SOCKET_RECEIVER when landed on the bay's SOCKET_LANDING facing +Z
sai93.engineNodes: BODY_HEAVE (Y 1.7 nominal); LEG_{FL,FR,RL,RR}_{YAW,HIP,KNEE,SHOCK_ROD,FOOT,ANCHORS} (hips at X/Z +-1.30, links 0.95 / 1.35 m, anchors 0.16 m stroke); THRUSTER_*_GIMBAL; MINING_LIFT, MINING_FOLD, AUGER_L_ROLL, AUGER_R_ROLL, INTAKE_SCREW_ROLL, LASER_L_AIM, LASER_R_AIM; ORE_WINDOW_MASK, ORE_GAUGE_FILL (scale.y = fill); OFFLOAD_STAGE_1/2 (0.69 m each)
sai93.runtime: assets/models/sai93/runtime.js: applySai93(THREE, scene, {fold, anchor, deploy, fill, offload, time, drillAngle, compression, bank, pitch, grounded, terrain}) (all 0-1 except the angles) and applyBay(scene, {ore, gas, battery}) for the shared bay; returns {static:true} on LOD2. mission.js (SAI-92's, byte-identical: dispatch/recall/addSite/tick, capacity 80, receiver 600, the first default mission ~55.78 s) is in the vault, not shipped
sai93.bay: the shared service bay is the SAI-92 bay, byte-identical (sha256 efa93366... LOD1, e1454345... LOD2): already pinned as assets/models/sai92/sai92_bay_d0_lod{1,2}.glb; root SAI92_BAY_ROOT, 10 x 9 m, 3.405 m tall; SOCKET_LANDING (0, 0.215, 0), SOCKET_RECEIVER (0, 1.87, 3.30), SOCKET_GAS_SUPPLY (-2.3, 1.78, -3.20), SOCKET_POWER_SUPPLY (2.3, 1.78, -3.20); BAY_ORE_LEVEL, BAY_GAS_LEVEL, BAY_POWER_LEVEL

tiers.lod2: static distance tier frozen landed with half ore, 2,496 triangles / 1 draw / 201,200 B; root extras static:true
